slow_simulator_note: The simulated clock runs at roughly 0.25x real time on this machine. What ages a grid map is wall-clock pipeline delay, but flight_manager compares that age against max_map_age_s in simulation seconds, so the same Faster-LIO/voxel-carving lag has to be compared in the same clock domain. The 2.0 s shipped default is crossed during ordinary flight and navigation is cancelled before the obstacle exists. DRONE_MAX_MAP_AGE_S is therefore raised to 4 simulation seconds for this experiment (the shipped default is unchanged), the driver records the age on every sample and the per-delta peak in group.json, and any navigation the deadline does cancel is re-issued by the driver as a bounded, recorded goal_resend event.

criteria.collision: truth conservative 0.40 m whole-airframe envelope clearance > 0
criteria.arrival: terminal COMPLETED and truth endpoint error <= 0.30 m
criteria.route_return: lateral deviation <= 0.35 m after passing the box
